translations.将安装 PawnIO {0} 内核驱动（作者 namazso，官方签名发行版），:
This installs the PawnIO {0} kernel driver (by namazso, the official signed release). DellFans uses it to read the CPU temperature (MSR).

Download from: {1}

Checks: the download must match the pinned SHA-256 fingerprint and carry an Authenticode signature from CN={2}. If either check fails, the installer is not run.

License: the driver is GPL-2.0 and is not bundled with DellFans; it is downloaded from the official address above only after you agree.

Needs administrator rights; Windows will ask you to confirm. You can uninstall it later from Windows Apps and features.
translations.尚未检测风扇控制接口 · 风扇保持 BIOS 自动；重新打开窗口可开始检测: Fan control interface not checked yet · the fan stays on BIOS automatic; reopen the window to start the check

translations.已临时交回 BIOS 自动；配置已保留，重启服务或重新应用模式可恢复。: Temporarily returned to BIOS automatic control. Settings are retained; restart the service or reapply the mode to resume.
